summary: Defines new TLS 1.2 and DTLS 1.2 cipher suites that combine ephemeral elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman with a pre-shared key for key exchange, using AES-GCM and AES-CCM authenticated encryption. They suit devices that share a secret in advance and still want fresh session keys.

eli5.summary: Two friends already know a secret handshake, and they also make up a new secret code for each chat. These are new recipes for doing both.

questions: tls psk with aes-gcm and aes-ccm
